text:
maria: follow-up from S3/backpressure postmortem — short, actionable test items and owners so we ship regressions into CI.

leo: please paste the list.

maria: TL;DR: three incident-driven tests + chaos drill + alert rule.
- P1: incident prompt bucket (captures truncated/fallback prompts). owner: leo. acceptance: CI detects the same fingerprint.
- P2: fallback regression harness (simulate pod drain -> fallback model, no 5xxs). owner: samir. acceptance: 3 consecutive staging runs pass.
- P3: load reproducer (fanout pattern, KV pressure). owner: anya. acceptance: reproduces 95/99 latency bump in staging.
- D1: quarterly 2hr chaos drill that runs P1-P3 with oncall present. owner: jordan.
- O1: alert correlation rule for recurring S3 errors. owner: ops.

leo: I'll take P1. plan to add tests/regression/incident_buckets/s3_backpressure.txt and a tiny pytest. ETA Thu.

anya: taking P3. will author a locust that sweeps KV hit ratios and coordinate ephemeral infra. ETA next Wed.

samir: taking P2 with eng-runtime. will add a staged drain canary and automated assertion that fallback is seamless. ETA 2w.

jordan: will own the drill. planning checklist and comms doc by Mon. drill next quarter.

ops-bot: Created tickets RWINF-1201..1205 for these items (links in JIRA).

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall handover tomorrow 09:00. react :bell: when acked.

maria: governance: label all incident-derived tests with `incident-regression` and require an owner before postmortem close. monthly sweep to retire stale buckets.

leo: local run for reviewers: `pytest tests/regression/test_incidents.py::test_s3_bucket -q`

anya: locust sketch: `class S3User(HttpUser): @task def gen(self): self.client.post('/v1/generate', json={'prompt':'...'})`

maria: timeline recap: P1 leo Thu, P3 anya Wed, P2 samir 2w, D1 jordan plan Mon. ops will deploy O1. please accept JIRA tickets and react :thumbsup:. I'll check status in next eng-sre sync. cheers.
